:::{#sol-argmax-scaled-quadratic}

Completing the [square](algebra.qmd#def-square) gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
f(x) &= 5\,(4x - x^2) \\
&= 20 - 5\,(x - 2)^2.
\end{aligned}
$$

The square $(x - 2)^2$ is never negative and is $0$ only at $x = 2$,
so $f(x) \le 20 = f(2)$ for every $x \in [0, 4]$,
with equality only at $x = 2$.
So $\argmax_{x \in [0, 4]} f(x) = \cb{2}$.

:::
